items.problem: The order of `UIOpenedEvent` and `PanelFlowFinishedEvent` within one panel transition is not set. Both `when` cells say "after the panel transition ends" (ui-core.md:347, ui-core.md:349), and the order rule at ui-core.md:352 ("in the order closed, opened") does not cover `PanelFlowFinishedEvent`. A subscriber that handles `PanelFlowFinishedEvent` of `open_panel` can see `UIOpenedEvent` of the new panel before or after it, depending on the implementation. This was already there before the diff and is unrelated to dropping the panel key
